existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `Appointment` has hard local breaking changes despite stable resource identity. The main concerns are renamed/removed fields, primitive-to-complex datatype replacements, loss of the `information-only` participant code, and R6-only recurrence/request/actor expressiveness. The top uncertainty is exact terminology and business-rule mapping for priority, reason, service type, and recurrence workflows.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be treated as a structural transform, not a version-label update. Most old data can be upgraded only by renaming or wrapping values (`cancelationReason`, `comment`, `reasonCode`, `serviceType`, `patientInstruction`) and by applying domain policy for semantic changes (`participant.required`, `priority`, unsupported reason targets). Downgrade from R6 needs extensions or manual review for recurrence, new reference targets, and new operational fields.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for StructureDefinition-level changes because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and compared directly, and relevant local CodeSystems for status/participant codes were checked. Confidence is lower for migration justification and terminology semantics because no official diff, Jira rationale, narrative guidance, or full terminology expansions were supplied.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Appointment keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 8 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 85/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: `cancelationReason` was renamed to `cancellationReason`
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 JSON/XML using `cancelationReason` is not the R6 element name, and generated code property names change.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `participant.required` changed from required code enum to boolean
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid, runtime/API/codegen, and semantic loss: R4 code values are not booleans, and `information-only` is not represented by the new boolean alone.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `priority` changed from unsigned integer to CodeableConcept
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: an R4 integer value is not an R6 CodeableConcept; reverse conversion from arbitrary coded priorities to a single unsigned integer is policy-dependent.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `serviceType` changed from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(HealthcareService)
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid, runtime/API/codegen, and R6-to-R4 loss: old coded values must be wrapped into CodeableReference, and R6 HealthcareService references may not downgrade cleanly to a CodeableConcept.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Reason reference targets changed: ImmunizationRecommendation removed, DiagnosticReport added
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Appointment whose reasonReference points to ImmunizationRecommendation has no base-valid R6 reason target for that same reference.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `comment` string was replaced by repeating `note` Annotation
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: old `comment` is not an R6 element; reverse conversion from multiple or attributed annotations to one string is potentially lossy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `reasonCode` and `reasonReference` were replaced by `reason` CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: old `reasonCode`/`reasonReference` properties are not the R6 wire shape; reverse conversion can lose CodeableReference grouping if R6 instances use paired concept/reference semantics.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `patientInstruction` changed from single string to repeating CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid, runtime/API/codegen, and R6-to-R4 loss: old strings must be wrapped; R6 referenced or multiple instructions cannot always be downgraded to a single R4 string without loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: New error invariant requires `start` to be less than or equal to `end`
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 data with `start` after `end` can become base-invalid under R6 validation.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds a native recurrence and appointment-series model not present in R4
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 recurrence semantics cannot be losslessly represented in base R4 Appointment without expansion or extensions.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
